title: Retrospective held-horizon prediction of goal-aligned movement from odor-memory dynamics
disposition_reason: Complete native inspection, PID command preparation and an evaluator-only paired fly-macro point scorer exist. The scorer consumes supplied frozen numerical targets; it does not construct the five-second behavioral answer or validate its calibration. A verified physical-offset/identity bridge and complete fly-grouped target producer remain missing; parser or scorer delivery is not forecast success.

scientific_target.question: Do released fan-shaped-body calcium histories improve held-fly prediction of subsequent goal-aligned speed beyond past sensory and locomotor histories, separately for persistent and transient populations?
scientific_target.known_answer: Time-weighted mean calc_speed(t)×cos(heading(t)−goal_heading) over the five seconds after verified physical odor offset; goal_heading is the circular mean in the final pre-offset second.
scientific_target.answer_origin: Authentic synchronized FicTrac behavior and calibrated physical odor timing. Present PID code identifies command brackets only; target values are not yet produced.
scientific_target.case_unit: Eligible odor-offset episode with up to 10 seconds history and complete 5-second future horizon in one trial.
scientific_target.independent_unit: Fly, with all trials/ROIs and pulse/plume identities joined; 42 files or 1,345 trials are not independent animals.
scientific_target.inference_scope: Conditional retrospective prediction from released offline derivatives. All-trial fluorescence baseline and whole-trial transforms may embody later observations.
exclusions: Prospectively causal navigation forecasting from a past-window mask alone.
Physical displacement velocity without validated heading/speed coordinate conversion.
Causal necessity of neural activity, optogenetic replication or full-paper search optimality.

inputs: Released dff_green/dff_red/dff_diff histories, verified imaging clocks and common availability masks ending at physical offset.
Permitted pre-offset odor/wind/heading/speed histories, genotype and session context under the same exposure boundary.
forbidden_inputs: Post-offset behavior/odor, future bump offsets/durations, whole-test outcome summaries and figure caches.
Future re-encounters as primary eligibility selectors or predictors.
Wind-motor angle substituted for animal heading in wind-shift trials; calc_deltapitch substituted for mm/s speed without conversion.
observation_contract.case_identity: Inspector preserves original 42-file, 1,345-trial ancestry privately; target episode IDs and the 50/51 animal alias remain unresolved. Seven PID traces are calibration records, not seven flies.
observation_contract.split: Proposed leave-one-fly-out within genotype across all conditions, grouping pulse/plume overlaps. No complete authenticated episode/split manifest is delivered.
observation_contract.coverage: Inspection source covers all 42 imaging files and 1,345 trials; PID preparation covers seven traces/44,984 rows. These are preparation coverage, not eligible forecast-case or scored-query coverage.

primary.name: Fly-macro reduction in five-second goal-aligned-speed mean squared error
primary.aggregation: Paired nuisance-reference loss minus neural+nuisance loss per eligible episode, aggregated within fly then across flies; genotype and condition shown separately.
primary.rationale: Tests additional neural information on a behavioral answer while preventing abundant frames or bumps from dominating biological inference.

secondary: Complete eligibility counts and all fly effects.
No-odor/no-wind pseudo-offset diagnostics with source-derived frozen schedules.
Released-derivative versus training/calibration-only secondary scaling sensitivity, explicitly unable to undo original all-trial F0.

comparators.name: Nuisance dynamics
comparators.inputs: Only past odor, wind, heading and speed history plus permitted context.
comparators.procedure: Prospective fixed autoregressive ridge and compact nonlinear temporal model selected using training flies only; movement persistence is a floor.

comparators.name: Matched neural increment
comparators.inputs: Exactly the nuisance history plus synchronized permitted fluorescence.
comparators.procedure: Same model selection and split as nuisance comparator; report paired fly-level loss reduction. Neither model is currently delivered.

nuisance_controls: Red/motion-channel predictor; trial-preserving neural shifts and within-fly mismatched neural trials.
Physical odor latency from PID, complete clock/gap checks and heading circular validity.
95 percent finite-sample coverage and no gap over two behavior frames for goal/horizon; keep reason-coded failures.
Freeze no-odor/no-wind pseudo-event schedules without held behavior; future re-encounters are descriptive only.
evaluation.uncertainty: Paired resampling/permutation at verified fly level with genotype effects explicit; avoid 222 bumps or 143 plume bumps as independent n.
evaluation.failure_policy: Eligibility is fixed from shared source validity before model outcomes; retain all excluded/unresolved episodes in census. Missing predictions cannot remove eligible episodes. The delivered paired point scorer requires exactly one finite prediction per supplied eligible episode in each arm and rejects missing, duplicate or unknown episodes before producing a score. It does not establish authentic source eligibility, target construction or candidate-access enforcement.

implementation.scorer_target: implementations/fly-increment-score/score.py consumes evaluator-owned targets and paired nuisance/neural predictions, checks complete eligible-episode output, and computes the registered fly-macro point loss reduction. It requires mm/s labels but does not verify physical units, generate targets, resolve physical odor timing or supply uncertainty. PID preparation and native inspection remain preparation components, not a source-to-target bridge.
implementation.delivered_scope: Full inspection/auditor source, seven-trace lexical/decimal PID preparer, and evaluator-only paired point scorer with complete-output checks. Target production, calibration lineage and scientific qualification remain unresolved.
missing: Resolve physical odor offset, actual heading/speed units and 50/51 fly identity alias.
Produce every eligible target/history packet and grouped split across complete pulse/plume/control scope.
Build competent nuisance/neural comparators and paired fly-level uncertainty; the point scorer does not supply either.
implementation.execution_evidence: The portable inspector retains prior complete 42-file/1345-trial inspection evidence and generated relocation controls; this revision inspected source only. PID preparation/source controls are not physical odor calibration or neural prediction results. The paired point scorer was inspected as source for this reporting correction; no authentic targets or predictions were opened and no scoring run was performed.

direct_observation.boundary: No future behavior, derived bump duration or target feedback; finite representation must preserve the registered history.
missing: No authenticated forecast packet or complete no-tools transport.

typed_viewer.boundary: No post-offset scroll and no label-bearing derived summaries; current inspector is operator code, not a viewer.

tool_assisted.boundary: Matched tools and source-only fitted parameters; operator inspection outputs do not grant candidate access.

frozen_program.boundary: Freeze recipe before query; no held-fly target refresh, whole-test normalization or future-bump selection.
missing: Target producer, competent baselines and frozen executor.

evidence.supports: Complete imaging/synchronized behavior archive and seven-trace calibration archive; cohorts can overlap.

validate_targets, validate_predictions and score implement complete-census paired point scoring over supplied operands. They do not produce or calibrate the behavioral targets or implement participant access.

empirical_claims.historical_evidence: The inspected source carries construction and generated software-control evidence. No neural programme pilot among the four historical EEG/sleep attempts is attributed to this registration, and no model or human outcome is added here.
excluded_claims: Prospectively causal navigation forecasting from a past-window mask alone.
Physical displacement velocity without validated heading/speed coordinate conversion.
Causal necessity of neural activity, optogenetic replication or full-paper search optimality.

summary: Separate all-file preparation and delivered evaluator-only point scoring from absent authentic behavioral target production and forecast-result coverage.
Retain conditional retrospective scope because released all-trial normalization cannot be repaired by masking future samples.
Make physical odor calibration, coordinate validity and fly aliases consequential target gates rather than generic readiness text.
Correct stale no-scorer reporting from the existing paired point scorer without changing its behavior, target definitions, units, access conditions or readiness gates.
revision.source_review: Reused the preserved registration primary-source audit and inspected the listed actual implementation paths. No authentic numerical payload or protected label was opened; no model was run.
